title: Replace a $2K/mo task in 20 minutes.
subtitle: A free AI workflow that chases your unpaid invoices for you.

title: Chasing money is everyone's worst job.
subtitle: Freelancers and agencies lose hours, and sleep, chasing late invoices. Perfect thing to hand to AI.

title: Three free tools, zero code.
body: A spreadsheet of who owes what, a free automation tool (Make or n8n), and an AI model to write the nudge. That's the whole setup.
tip: Make's free tier covers about 1,000 runs a month. Plenty for a solo shop.

title: The nudge writer
prompt: Write a payment reminder for an invoice that is [X] days overdue. Client: [NAME]. Amount: [AMOUNT]. Keep it 4 sentences, warm but firm, no guilt-tripping, clear next step to pay. Give me 3 versions: gentle, firm, and final notice.

title: The 20-minute build.
body: 1. List unpaid invoices in a sheet. 2. Connect it to Make. 3. When an invoice passes 7 days, fire the prompt. 4. It drafts the right nudge and emails it. You approve, it sends.
tip: Start manual: run the prompt yourself and send one today. Automate once it works.

title: This is a business, not a chore.
subtitle: The same workflow, sold to other freelancers, is a real product (it's on every validated idea list). Solve your own pain first, then sell the fix.

title: Do the manual version today.
subtitle: Paste the prompt, send one overdue nudge in the next 20 minutes. Save this for when you automate it.
